programme.title: Rock'n Troll
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet deliver an elf house to a boy named Magnus in Iceland.

programme.title: Super Pet Sweet Up Surprise
programme.desc: The SWs and crew land World Aircraft at World Airport for a day of cleaning their ship.

programme.title: The Great Desert Dash

programme.title: Little Bugs Big Trouble
programme.desc: Jett delivers a bug shaped safari suit to a boy named Adrian in La Fortuna, Costa Rica! It's a big day as Adrian is going to lead his friends on a bug safari located on his parents zip line course.

programme.title: Lost Toys In Dreamland
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet deliver a teddy bear to a girl named Rachel who lost her favourite teddy bear, Ute. With Astra and AP's help, they must then enter Rachel's dream, and find Ute in Dreamland Station.

programme.title: Broadcast Station Commotion
programme.desc: Jett delivers a special child minder wrist link to Yeojun, a young Korean boy, so he can look after his younger brother Yeowoon as they follow their Dad to a big tv studio.

programme.title: Puppet Problems In Pilsen
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet are called to the Czech Republic to deliver a marionette for a town's Historical Weekend Festival. Golden Boy steals the spotlight and gets caught in a giant Golem puppet.

programme.title: Alien Movie Stars
programme.desc: Jett delivers special movie making equipment to a boy named Riley who wants to be a film director.

programme.title: Flying Clouds Of Colour
programme.desc: Jett calls on Paul to assist a girl in India.

programme.title: My New Neighbor
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet are called to Dunedin, New Zealand.

programme.title: Runaway Piggy Bank
programme.desc: Jett delivers a robotic Piggy Bank to a boy in Italy.

programme.title: The Rain Dragon
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet help bring a gift to a legendary dragon.

programme.title: Newfoundland Snow Wonderland
programme.desc: Jett delivers a wool hat and gloves to a girl in Canada.

programme.title: Happy Birthday Fishes
programme.desc: Jett and Jett Pet deliver special envelopes.

programme.title: Happy Mother's Day
programme.desc: Jett attempts to deliver flowers for Mother's Day.

programme.title: There's A Shark In My Water Park
programme.desc: Jett delivers a large wagon for an aquarium.

programme.title: Pasta Wars
programme.desc: There is a space invasion under Jon Arbuckle's roof, and the aliens are looking very much like Garfield's favourite meal: lasagnas.

programme.title: A Game of Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: Squeak and his mice family have taken up residence in Garfield's house, to Jon's despair, who will deprive Garfield of lasagnas if he doesn't turn things back to normal.

programme.title: Perfect Pizza
programme.desc: Garfield's favourite restaurant, Vito's Pizzeria, is in jeopardy. The evil Mama Meany wants to buy it to expand his own restaurant, with the PizzaGrand 7000 capable of making ten pizzas a minute.

programme.title: Mother Garfield
programme.desc: A mother bluebird is locked in a neighbourhood garage, so who will care for her eggs? That's a job for Garfield, who is sometimes quite a mother hen.

programme.title: Pup in the Pound
programme.desc: Odie is found by Al the Dogcatcher with no license on his collar so he puts him in the city pound with other stray dogs. Garfield will do everything to get his friend back.

programme.title: Odie in Love
programme.desc: Odie falls in love with a brush. Garfield becomes a little bit jealous about that and decides to make the brush disappear.

programme.title: Not So Sweet Sound of Music
programme.desc: Jon finds an old accordion. It's unbearable for Garfield who totally dislikes this music. He will do everything to get rid of it.

programme.title: Turkey Trouble
programme.desc: Jon has won a live turkey in a raffle and wants to prepare it for dinner, but he can't make up his mind to eat it. Neither can Garfield!

programme.title: Catnap
programme.desc: Garfield and Odie are watching a horror movie... They're scared. Jon, who has forgotten his key, is knocking at the door. The two pets won't let him in until he's proven his identity.

programme.title: Agent X
programme.desc: Garfield is angry. A fake, secret agent is trying to steal the show and his popularity among his friends.

programme.title: Orange and Black
programme.desc: It's Halloween! Garfield goes trick or treating and disguises himself as a scary Catzilla. But the real Catzilla has just escaped from the city zoo and will spread panic in Garfield's neighbourhood.

programme.title: Freaky Monday
programme.desc: Odie has been thrown out of the house by Garfield and spends all night outside on his own. An alien crashes his UFO in the garden and loses a key part necessary to get back home!

programme.title: King Nermal
programme.desc: Nermal's owner has gone away on vacation and Jon has offered to look after Nermal while he's gone. Watch out, everybody! The cutest kitten in the world he says so himself is coming over for a week!

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Pooky
programme.desc: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

programme.title: Curse of the Were-Dog
programme.desc: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

programme.title: Down on the Farm
